inlines.v: COMPREHENSIBLY, adverb With great extent of embrace, or comprehension; with large extent of signification; in a manner to comprehend a large circuit. The words wisdom and righteousness are commonly used very comprehensibly so as to signify all religion and virtue. This word is rarely used.
